def split_csv(line):
    """
    Parse one line of CSV and return its fields as a list of strings.
    Returns None if the line is malformed.
    
    Fields are separated by commas. A field that starts with a double quote is quoted:
    it ends at the next double quote that is not part of a doubled pair (""), and
    commas inside quoted fields are literal. The closing quote must be followed by
    a comma or the end of the line. A field that does not start with a double quote
    runs to the next comma and must not contain a double quote. An unterminated
    quoted field is malformed.
    """
    if line == "":
        return [""]
    
    fields = []
    i = 0
    
    while i <= len(line):
        # Check if this position starts a new field (after comma or at start)
        if i == len(line):
            # End of line reached - we've successfully parsed all fields
            break
        
        # Check if field starts with a quote
        if line[i] == '"':
            # Quoted field
            i += 1
            field = ""
            while i < len(line):
                if line[i] == '"':
                    # Check if it's a doubled quote or the end of field
                    if i + 1 < len(line) and line[i + 1] == '"':
                        # Doubled quote - add one quote to field
                        field += '"'
                        i += 2
                    else:
                        # End of quoted field
                        i += 1
                        # Next character must be comma or end of line
                        if i < len(line) and line[i] != ',':
                            return None
                        if i < len(line):  # consume the comma
                            i += 1
                        fields.append(field)
                        break
                else:
                    field += line[i]
                    i += 1
            else:
                # Reached end of line while in quoted field - unterminated
                return None
        else:
            # Unquoted field
            field = ""
            while i < len(line) and line[i] != ',':
                if line[i] == '"':
                    # Unquoted fields must not contain quotes
                    return None
                field += line[i]
                i += 1
            
            fields.append(field)
            
            if i < len(line):  # consume the comma
                i += 1
    
    return fields
